text: 你、诺曼和西尔维娅把伯纳德抬到林间空地的庇护处，试图让他暖和起来，却毫无用处。他陷入昏迷，黄昏时死亡。
那晚你几乎没睡。剩下的同伴在睡袋里辗转反侧。天刚亮，你们便在空地埋葬伯纳德。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 635
text: You, Norman, and Sylvia carry Bernard to the shelter of the glade and try to warm him up. It does no good. He enters a coma and dies at dusk.
You get very little sleep that night. Your remaining companions turn, restless in their bedrolls. At first light, you bury Bernard in the glade.
